REQUIRED_INSTALL.name: Git
REQUIRED_INSTALL.notes: Needed to clone marine-tracker and the two external tool repos.

REQUIRED_INSTALL.name: Python
REQUIRED_INSTALL.notes: Standard library only is used by setup_workstation.py; no pip packages required for the installer itself.

REQUIRED_INSTALL.name: Node.js/npm
REQUIRED_INSTALL.notes: Required to build/run KiCAD-MCP-Server and the project-local mcp-server/ guard server.

REQUIRED_INSTALL.name: Rust/Cargo
REQUIRED_INSTALL.notes: Required only if rebuilding custom Konnect (konnect-codex) from source via --build-konnect.

REQUIRED_INSTALL.name: KiCad
REQUIRED_INSTALL.notes: Must match or exceed the version the project was verified against.

REQUIRED_INSTALL.name: Claude Code
REQUIRED_INSTALL.notes: Primary agent used for PCB work on this project.

OPTIONAL.name: Codex CLI
OPTIONAL.notes: Used if configuring Codex to also reach custom Konnect. Not fatal if absent.

OPTIONAL.name: Gemini CLI
OPTIONAL.notes: Not found on source machine at packaging time. Gemini's Konnect wiring is documented but was not fully CLI-verified on the source machine either. Not fatal if absent.

REQUIRED_EXTERNAL_REPO.name: konnect-codex
REQUIRED_EXTERNAL_REPO.role: Custom upgraded Konnect build used by Claude (and recommended for Codex).

REQUIRED_EXTERNAL_REPO.name: KiCAD-MCP-Server
REQUIRED_EXTERNAL_REPO.role: Generic KiCad MCP server used by Claude.

REQUIRED_EXTERNAL_PLUGIN.name: stock Konnect KiCad plugin
REQUIRED_EXTERNAL_PLUGIN.role: Used by Gemini only, via .agents/mcp_config.json. Must not be silently substituted with the custom build.

PROJECT_LOCAL.role: Claude project MCP config (konnect + kicad servers). Rendered by setup_workstation.py --configure from templates/claude.mcp.template.json.
Claude project permissions. Preserved as-is by setup_workstation.py unless a machine-specific path literally requires replacement.
Gemini project MCP config (stock konnect). Rendered by setup_workstation.py --configure from templates/gemini.mcp.template.json.
Project-local guard MCP server already committed to the repo; independent of Konnect/KiCAD-MCP-Server. Build with npm install && npm run build if Codex/Gemini guard integration is used.
Existing example Codex config for the project-local guard MCP; unrelated to Konnect wiring.
Existing example Gemini config for the project-local guard MCP; unrelated to Konnect wiring.

SECRET_OR_MANUAL.status: not currently used by this project; documented only as a placeholder for potential future KobAI integration
